title: Pay ASIC's annual review fee
what: Companies (and some schemes and other bodies) pay a review fee to ASIC on each review date; the amounts are set by regulation.

sources.title: Corporations (Review Fees) Act 2003
sources.quote: 5 Imposition of review fees (1) Subject to section 6, the regulations may prescribe fees in relation to the review dates of the following: (a) companies;
